name: venky-yadav-caterings
description: Venky Yadav Caterings & Cafe — Premium Hospitality Platform (client + server monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @vyc/server" "npm run dev -w @vyc/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vyc/server && npm run build -w @vyc/client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @vyc/server" "npm run start -w @vyc/client"
